resources.string: Mihon Extension Network Profiles
Tune extension networking without changing the rest of Miyorare.

Mihon-compatible extensions now support Adaptive, Standard, Aggressive, and Custom network profiles. Custom mode can control connection timeout, safe retries, retry delay, temporary-error backoff, and per-source host overrides.
Settings → Storage & Network → Mihon Extensions
Choose Adaptive for the recommended behavior, or use another profile when a specific extension needs faster failure handling or more tolerance.
Source WebView Access
Open a source website when login, cookies, or a browser challenge is needed.
Mihon-compatible sources can now be opened in the internal WebView so browser sessions can be refreshed without leaving the source flow.
Source → Menu → WebView
Open WebView from the source menu, complete the required login or challenge, then return to Miyorare and retry the source.
Smarter Related Manga
Related titles are grouped into focused, scrollable suggestions.

Related Manga can now use bounded multi-keyword groups with horizontal carousels and Show All actions. Related loading waits until the main Details data is ready so chapters and primary information stay responsive.
Manga Details → Related
Open Related from Manga Details, swipe through each suggestion group, or tap Show All to see more results for that keyword.
Large Library Loading Modes
Choose lower memory use or prepare the full list for direct scrolling.

Favourites and Downloaded now offer Paged and Full loading modes. Paged uses adaptive batches for lower memory use, while Full prepares all list metadata and still keeps cover loading close to the visible area.
Settings → Favourites → List loading mode
Keep Paged for the recommended balance. Use Full when you prefer direct long-distance scrolling through a very large library.
Chapter Download Actions
Start a chapter download directly from its action menu.
Chapter cards now provide a download action menu with a Start now option, giving you clearer control over what should enter the download flow.
Manga Details → Chapter → Download action
Open the chapter download action and choose Start now when you want that chapter to begin downloading.
Faster Download Queue Feedback
Pause, resume, and cancel actions now show their transition immediately.

Download queue state handling and notifications were refined so queued work reacts more clearly. Pausing, resuming, and cancelling now expose their in-progress state instead of appearing unresponsive.
Downloads
Use Pause, Resume, or Cancel normally; Miyorare now shows the transition while the worker finishes applying the requested state.
